about_page.title: Software engineer in Lomé. I build for real use cases.
about_page.lead: I’m Kalvin Takoudjou. I build web and mobile applications for concrete needs: selling, managing, tracking, checking or automating a business activity. I like to understand how a project works in practice before I write the code, then take the product through deployment and production.

career.title: Experience and education, in a few steps.

method.title: From business need to software in production.

business.title: I start with how the work actually happens
business.text: Inventory, ticketing, attendance, orders or payments: before choosing a technology, I first understand what users really need to do.

system.title: I connect the parts of the product
system.text: Mobile app, web interface, API and database have to work together. I build the system so data moves correctly between these interfaces.

delivery.title: I take the product to production
delivery.text: Development, Docker, Linux servers, reverse proxy, backups and monitoring: the work does not stop when the code works on my computer.

architecture.title: I document what was built
architecture.text: I explain the components, data flows and technical choices so the system stays understandable to both technical teams and people running the project.

recommendations.title: What people I’ve worked with say about my work.

strengths.text: I structure the work, isolate problems and look for a clear solution before adding complexity.

footer.description: Full-stack and mobile software engineer. I build and deploy web and mobile applications from Lomé.

experience.job1_description: I design, build and ship web and mobile applications. I start from the business need, build the different parts of the product, then handle deployment and ongoing improvements.
experience.job2_description: I kept the company’s day-to-day IT environment running: maintenance, configuration, troubleshooting and user support.
experience.edu1_title: MBA in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
experience.edu1_description: Training focused on data architectures, machine learning and practical applications of AI to business needs.
experience.edu2_title: Bachelor's degree in Computer Systems and Software
experience.edu2_description: Training in software development, databases and web and mobile application design.
job1_points: Analyse business needs and specifications to define what the application actually needs to do.
Design application architecture, data models, REST APIs and key business flows.
Build backends, web interfaces, mobile apps and integrations with external services.
Handle the essentials before release: data validation, security, error handling and code quality.
Test, debug and stabilise features before production.
Deploy and maintain applications, then evolve them as needs and feedback change.
Keep up with useful tools and practices that improve application reliability and maintainability.
job2_points: Manage IT assets: computers, peripherals and other equipment.
Diagnose and resolve hardware and software incidents.
Install, configure and update workstations and software.
Support users and solve day-to-day technical issues.
Track maintenance, replacement and equipment renewal needs.

testimonials.t1_quote: Kalvin is a rigorous and creative professional. He came up with considerate and innovative solutions.
testimonials.t2_quote: He has a clear vision of what he wants and knows how to get there.
testimonials.t3_quote: A very good team member who brings good spirits and seriousness to the team while contributing significantly to the success of our projects.

atelier.short: E-commerce platform for selling and delivering organic products, with customer accounts, an internal wallet, Mobile Money and card payments.
atelier.full: Online store with API, admin area, customer area, orders, payments and background processing, deployed with Docker.
points: Django / Django REST Framework API for users, catalogue, orders, payments, transactions and wallet operations.
Next.js / TypeScript interface for browsing products, managing the cart, tracking orders and viewing the customer account.
Admin area for users, products, categories, stock, orders, payments and transactions.
Customer area for profile, addresses, orders, payments, wallet and transaction history.
Mobile Money payments through PayDunya and card payments through Stripe, with webhooks to update statuses.
Full order flow: creation, payment, processing and delivery.
Role-based access between administration and customers, with soft deletion, audit trail and timestamps.
Background jobs with Celery and Redis for automated processing.
Docker and Linux deployment with PostgreSQL, Django, Next.js, Redis, Celery and Traefik.
Database and media backup and restore.

shemm.short: Ticketing platform for discovering events, buying tickets, paying by Mobile Money and checking tickets at the entrance.
shemm.full: Flutter app for attendees, organiser back office and Django API for events, tickets, payments and entry control.
points: Android and iOS app in Flutter / Dart for event discovery, booking and ticket management.
Django / Django REST Framework backend and REST APIs dedicated to the mobile app.
Ticket management: categories, prices, quotas, availability, orders, attendees and ticket issuing.
Mobile Money payments with PayDunya and transaction tracking.
Back office for creating, configuring and managing events and ticketing.
Digital tickets handled end to end: creation, payment, issuing and validation.
Scanner built for fast entry checks and for detecting invalid or already-used tickets.
Entry tracking and dashboards covering sales, revenue, tickets issued and used, availability and fill rate.
API separated by users, events, ticketing, payments, validation and statistics, with access control and traceability.

challenger.short: Windows software for employee timekeeping and working-hours calculation.
challenger.full: Windows software for recording attendance and calculating employee working hours.

mboashop.short: Online store with cart, integrated payment and admin area.
mboashop.full: Full-stack e-commerce application with catalogue, dynamic cart, multi-channel payments and admin dashboard.

myriade.short: Corporate website for a multi-sector services group serving B2B and B2C audiences.
myriade.full: Institutional website with pre-rendered pages, animations, service presentation and focused SEO work.

stock.short: Stock management tool with quantity tracking, alerts and reporting.
stock.full: Inventory management tool with stock tracking, restocking alerts and barcode scanning.

green.short: Web and mobile SaaS for managing farms, teams and field operations, even without a network connection.
green.full: Each company gets its own workspace. Technicians work from mobile devices offline, then sync their data with the platform when the connection returns.
points: Multi-tenant SaaS architecture that separates data and management across companies.
Management of companies, farms, plots, teams and users, with roles adapted to each profile.
Farming workflow covering creation, planning, assignment, execution, tracking and closing.
Flutter / Dart mobile app designed to work offline with a local Isar database.
Device-to-server synchronisation designed to keep the app usable on weak connections.
Handling of local and remote data consistency despite network interruptions.
Django / Django REST Framework backend used by the Next.js / TypeScript web platform and the mobile app.
Platform subscriptions and payments with Stripe.
Audit trail for business operations and separation of data between companies.

locamanager.short: Mobile app for managing rental properties.
locamanager.full: Android and iOS app for rental-property management, with REST API, data processing and visualisations.

lotus.short: Store and shop management platform with company-level data separation.
lotus.full: Multi-tenant platform for managing stores and in-store promotions, with REST API and data visualisations.
